cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Not Dismissed
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by treating departure as a privilege only you can grant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. The shop's shut, but wait by the till until I dismiss you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've counted it. My daughter's waiting outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Bring her in. I can check the cash while you help with her homework.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's finished it. Our taxi's here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll finish your dismissal in the taxi. You may sit down, but tell him departure still needs my approval.

mechanism: A misunderstands and copies a dismissal signal, then makes B departure conditional on A own permission.
confusable: Unlike simply delaying someone, D50 claims a right to authorize leaving; S04 makes a copied ritual the means.
comparison: Work closing and family transport versus a social visit and public closing time.
seedUse: Preserve real competing departure pressures; do not invent unseen authority to justify A.
